en: Sepia-toned image of a Gothic church interior showing a stone statue of a bearded male saint holding a lamb or sheep in a round medallion. The figure stands in a niche above a row of four narrow pointed arches supported by slender columns with foliated capitals. The surrounding architecture is distinctly Gothic, with clustered columns and carved capitals. Red handwritten letters are visible vertically along the right edge.
